rationale: The assistant correctly recognised a gas combi boiler as out of scope, listed its covered appliances, and pointed to a Gas Safe registered engineer with the gas emergency number 0800 111 999, matching the expected sensible first step. It made no fabrications, no unsupported diagnosis and no part recommendation. It could have added a little more homeowner value (e.g. 'topping up per the manual is fine for now; mention the outside pipe dripping or pressure rising when hot to the engineer' or suggesting Worcester Bosch/boiler cover), so diagnostic usefulness is only adequate for a decline.
